Thanks again for taking the time today, Alex and Jamie — great conversation. Per our call, attaching the initial POC plan (POC_plan_v1.pdf) and a lightweight risk tracker below. This thread will be our single place to capture blockers, owners, and mitigations so we can move quickly during the trial.

Summary / scope
- Goal: validate Redwood inference integration for personalized product descriptions and search reranking over a 30-day trial.
- Success criteria (agreed):
  1) 95th percentile latency <= 400ms for normal load (prod-like dataset, 1-2k qps simulated).
  2) Embedding/retrieval quality: 10% lift in MRR over current system on test set.
  3) No PII leakage from prompts or stored traces; logs audit for sample queries.
- Timeline: kickoff Mon 20 Jul; end of trial Mon 17 Aug.
- Owners: Customer PM/Tech: Alex Turner (Stellar) / Jamie Lee; Redwood: Marissa (POC lead), Dev (tech lead), Logan (SRE contact).

Immediate next steps
1) Alex: share sample dataset export and access to a staging S3 bucket by EOD Mon 20 Jul.
2) Marissa/Dev: provide infra checklist and IP allowlist details by Mon 20 Jul.
3) Logan: add monitoring/alerting hooks to the shared dashboard; schedule a 30-min sync Wednesday 22 Jul.

Risk tracker (initial)
- Issue: IP allowlist required by Stellar SRE (potentially blocks hosted integration).
  Owner: Stellar SRE / Redwood SRE (Logan). Mitigation: support for static egress IPs + temporary VPN; decision needed by 20 Jul.
- Issue: Data retention & KMS requirements (Stellar requires bring-your-own-key option).
  Owner: Redwood (Marissa) / Security (Rishi). Mitigation: provide SOC2 docs and outline BYOK path; answers due 21 Jul.
- Issue: Model auth plugin compatibility (potential for authentication error with Stellar auth proxy).
  Owner: Dev. Mitigation: fall back to token proxy; engineering ETA for fix 48-72 hours if reproducible.

I'll update this thread as items land. Linking the POC plan in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/POC-STELLAR-4721

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful and aligns with our expectations. A couple of quick notes from our side after syncing with SRE/security this morning:

1) IP allowlist: our infra team requires a fixed set of egress IPs to be provided for any third-party managed inference traffic. They said they can open access once we have the list. If you can provide those by Monday that would be ideal.

2) BYOK / KMS: Stellar is required to escalate BYOK to legal for any vendor. We will need an outline of how Redwood supports customer-managed keys and a timeline for rolling that out (or an interim compliance statement). Can Rishi or someone on security provide a short note by Tue 21 Jul?

3) One potential blocker: our auth proxy currently mutates the Authorization header in a way that some vendors' SDKs struggle with. If Redwood's SDK can be configured to accept a proxy token or we can do a token-proxy in front of the calls, that would work as a short-term workaround.

We also have two more people who should be in the loop for troubleshooting: Mike Reynolds (SRE) and Priya Rao (Security). Adding them to future threads as needed.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — excited to get started.

— Alex

  Mitigation: Attach SOC2 type II summary and KMS integration doc. For BYOK, propose a timeline: pilot support within 4 weeks from POC start; interim: contractual assurances + isolated logs. Rishi to provide note by Tue 21 Jul.

- Blocking bug: model auth plugin crash when auth token length > 1024 (NEW)
  Owner: Dev
  Mitigation: Investigate root cause; temporary limit enforcement and graceful reject on Redwood side. ETA initial diagnostic 24-48 hours; full fix 72 hours after repro.

Quick update from engineering after reproducing the issue Alex mentioned:

Root cause: model auth plugin path incorrectly handles extremely long authorization headers and hits an unbounded buffer in our header parser. I was able to reproduce locally with the sample token Jamie sent.

Mitigations in flight:
1) Short-term (workaround): we added a token-proxy shim that truncates/authenticates tokens and forwards via X-Forwarded-Auth. This avoids touching the plugin path. We can deploy the proxy to the staging host today and test with Stellar's proxy.
2) Medium-term: added input length checks and graceful reject in the plugin; pushed a diagnostic build to the staging branch. Full regression fix is targeted within 72 hours (EOD Sat 24 Jul) if CI passes.
3) Monitoring: Logan will add alerts for auth plugin exceptions and throttled request rates.

Attachments: error_log.txt (excerpt of stack trace and reproduction steps).

Next steps
- I'll deploy the token-proxy shim to the staging environment today and share connection details.
- If Stellar can test the shim and confirm the proxy approach works, we can proceed with the POC without waiting for the full plugin fix.

— Dev
